claims.statement: April 15 Assembly considered government's April 6 withdrawal request; original bill submitted March 21
July 22 Act 35 temporarily suspended grain purchase law article 3, not entire statute
Act 35 allowed grain trade and transport but retained anti-hoarding penalties
April 15 agriculture minister stated he entered office March 2 and the ministry budget ranked fifth
July 22 Act 36 temporarily prohibited disposition of vested assets except farmland
July 23 grain prices were reportedly raised by an average 36 percent
Commerce ministry reportedly requested 61.8 million won for mine food procurement
September 29 report states Yeongwol generated 27.71 percent of capacity
ECA reportedly opposed new intermediary in US-aid civilian goods distribution
September 22 examination notice scheduled first higher civil-service exam for November 26
September 26 Court Organization Act defined district high and supreme court jurisdiction
September 29 Muccio no.1211 and Webb no.817 telegram catalog entries exist but full text not accessed
